verdict.rationale: Chat notifications are a fair question for a code-hosting platform, but nothing in the evidence documents sending repository or pull request notifications to Slack, Discord, or Microsoft Teams. The generic partner-integration claims never name chat tools. The community mention of using free HipChat alongside Bitbucket does not say Bitbucket sends notifications to it, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send repository and pull request notifications to chat tools like Slack, Discord, or Microsoft Teams
